title: Hitler regime support for Zionist revolutionary groups

tellings.quote: the the Hitler regime did lend support to the uh at that time the sort of Zionist movement to

plain: In the years before and during the Second World War, Hitler's government in Germany gave some support to the Zionist movement, the campaign to found a Jewish state in what was then British-ruled Palestine. A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown says this in passing, without naming a source. He brings it up as an example of unlikely hidden alliances behind world events.
